bioAdditions:
James was still farming in Plymouth in August 1860, aged 61, with real estate valued at $1,200 (more than double the $500 of 1850); his wife Elizabeth (57) and youngest son Edwin (18) were at home, together with a seven-year-old, Mary Williams, perhaps a grandchild or a bound girl, and his son Andrew had set up house next door (S1). By 29 July 1870 James, 71, was living in Andrew's household and Elizabeth was no longer listed, so she had probably died between 1860 and 1870 (S2). James therefore died after July 1870, not in 1909 as the FamilySearch profile says.

The FamilySearch profile (KP7T-1HK) is a merge of two different men. It attaches the 1867 Toronto marriage of Thomas Murray Pringle, aged 28, born in Scotland, son of 'James & Mary Pringle' (S3), and gives this James children born at Ruthven, Angus, Scotland, in 1834 and 1839. That Scottish James and his wife Mary are evidently the source of the 'second wife Mary' on the profile, which has been identified with Mary Steele (1808-1876). But FamilySearch's own Mary Steele profile shows her as the wife of John Linskill (d. 1865), mother of six Linskill children born in Lehman Twp 1833-48, living as 'Mary Linchkill' in 1860, and buried as Mary Steele Linskill at Huntsville, Jackson Twp (S4). No record of a marriage between Johnny's James and Mary (Steele) Linskill was found; the 'second marriage' should be treated as an error unless a record turns up. (Mary Steele was a daughter of Peter Steele and Charity Lamoreaux, so she was James's first cousin, which may also have helped the confusion.)

conflicts.foundValue: Mary Steele was Mrs John Linskill (widowed 1865), buried as Linskill; the 'Mary' wife on James's profile comes from a Scottish James & Mary Pringle of Toronto
conflicts.assessment: Probably a FamilySearch merge error. Recommend not adding Mary Steele as James's wife.

openQuestionsResolved.question: Confirm second marriage to Mary Steele.
openQuestionsResolved.answer: Not confirmed and probably false: the FamilySearch profile merges a Scottish James Pringle (wife Mary; son Thomas Murray Pringle b. Scotland, m. Toronto 1867), and Mary Steele was the widow of John Linskill, buried under that name.

openQuestionsResolved.question: Death date and place (FS '1909' impossible).
openQuestionsResolved.answer: Partly: alive at 71 on 29 Jul 1870 in son Andrew's household in Plymouth Twp; death after that date (not found).

openQuestionsNew: Elizabeth (Croup) Pringle is absent from the 1870 household: did she die 1860-70, or was she living elsewhere?
Look for James in the 1880 census and mortality schedule (1879-80) and for burial at Scott Cemetery, Huntington Mills (FamilySearch claim, unsourced).
